title: fix: update stale pip-position copy in test harness
body:
## Summary

Two stale strings in `/test-card-chrome` left over after the pip moved from top-left to top-right in PR #31:

- Intro paragraph: `"top-left dot"` → `"top-right dot, in the metadata cluster"`
- Visual checklist: `"Two empty icon-slot placeholders top-right of every card header"` → `"Confidence pip + two empty icon-slot placeholders in top-right cluster"`

Dev harness only — no production code changed.
